snippet.title: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts - Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3055670/Risk_of_Rain_2_Hallowed_Concepts/

Available today, October 8th 2026, on Steam, XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Epic Games Store.

Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts is the fourth DLC expansion for Risk of Rain 2. Hallowed Concepts takes players deeper into the dark, cult-like world of N’Kuhana. 
In this new expansion, survivors will fight through haunting new regions of Petrichor V, face horrific new bosses and enemies, and uncover powers never before possible in Risk of Rain 2.

Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3055670/Risk_of_Rain_2_Hallowed_Concepts/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/risk-of-rain-2--hallowed-concepts 
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0292-PPSA06516_00-RISKOFRAIN2SIEA0

--

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
